observations.why: it named God, Christ and Sarah's womb among the ones who consider; in these verses they are what is considered

actions.new_text: The persons named in the accounts of faith and of a decision are those who consider and those they consider: Sarah, who counts the promiser faithful, in Heb 11:11; God, counted able, in Heb 11:19; Christ, whose reproach is counted, in Heb 11:26; Sarah, whose womb is considered, in Rom 4:19; and in Mat 1:20 Joseph, son of David, considering while an angel of the Lord comes.
actions.checked: Heb 11:19, Heb 11:26 and Rom 4:19 (God, Christ and Sarah are what is considered, not the ones who consider)
actions.reason: evidence validation (B5): it named God, Christ and Sarah's womb among the ones who consider; in these verses they are what is considered

observations.why: it named the potter as the one regarded in Lam 4:2; there the sons of Zion are counted as the potter's pots

actions.new_text: People are named as those regarded or counted as something: Nabal in 1Sa 25:25, a brother in 2Th 3:15 and 1Pe 5:12, servants of Christ in 1Cor 4:1, Christ known by the flesh in 2Cor 5:16, masters in 1Ti 6:1, rulers named by Jesus in Mar 10:42, the potter in Isa 29:16, the sons of Zion in Lam 4:2, man in Isa 33:8, the men in Exo 5:9, the treasurers in Neh 13:13, and Solomon whose silver counts for nothing in 1Ki 10:21 and 2Ch 9:20.
actions.checked: Lam 4:2 (the precious sons of Zion are regarded as earthen pots)
actions.reason: evidence validation (B5): it named the potter as the one regarded in Lam 4:2; there the sons of Zion are counted as the potter's pots
